python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
MD="/Users/dct/.factory/missions/e194b9e3-6a67-42b9-bfc9-dd4e1ac23b0c"
cp=MD+"/validation-contract.md"
s=open(cp).read()
summary=[]
def rep(cid, old, new, note=""):
    global s
    n=s.count(old)
    if n!=1:
        print(f"FAIL {cid}: old fragment count={n}: {old[:80]!r}"); sys.exit(1)
    s=s.replace(old,new)
    summary.append((cid,old,new,note))

# C-1
rep("C-1",
 r"""`rg -n '\[u64; 7\]|\[usize; 7\]|\[Lane; 7\]|BETWEEN 1 AND 7|lanes\.len\(\), 7' crates apps --glob '*.rs' --glob '*.sql' --glob '!**/tests/**' --glob '!**/0001_init.sql'`""",
 r"""`rg -n '\[u64; 7\]|\[usize; 7\]|\[Lane; 7\]|BETWEEN 1 AND 7|lanes\.len\(\), 7|repeat\(7' crates apps --glob '*.rs' --glob '*.sql' --glob '*.css' --glob '!**/tests/**' --glob '!**/0001_init.sql'`""")
rep("C-1 (Fail clause, adjacent)",
 "Fail on any `Lane::` path, any 7-sized lane array or CHECK outside `0001_init.sql`,",
 "Fail on any `Lane::` path, any 7-sized lane array, `repeat(7` grid or CHECK outside `0001_init.sql`,",
 "adjacent Fail clause made to agree with the widened grep")
# C-1b
rep("C-1b",
 "shows at least one iteration site in `view/board.rs`, in `view/post_mortem.rs`, in `observatory-cli/src/replay.rs` and in `ui/src/lanes.rs` (and in `metrics` once it exists at M5)",
 r"shows at least one iteration site in `view/board.rs`, in `view/post_mortem.rs` and in `ui/src/lanes.rs` (and in `metrics` once it exists at M5), and `rg -n 'template\.(lanes|lane_text|lane|index|name_of)\(' crates/observatory-cli/src` shows that `replay.rs` and `inspect.rs` resolve every lane through the template (a method call on the template counts: the CLI prints one line per event and has no lane loop of its own)")
# C-1c
rep("C-1c",
 "Tests may name the lanes of the template they load (the default or `four_step`);",
 "Tests may name the lanes of the template they load (the default or `four_step`) and compare counts with `template.lanes.len()`, never with a literal;")
# C-2
rep("C-2 (diff)",
 "`diff ai/design/ui-kit-v2/theme.css <the file the app serves, e.g. apps/observatory-app/ui/style/theme.css or the Trunk asset>`",
 "`diff ai/design/ui-kit-v2/theme.css apps/observatory-app/ui/theme.css`")
rep("C-2 (rg)",
 r"""`rg -n -i '#[0-9a-f]{3}\b|#[0-9a-f]{6}\b|rgb\(' apps/observatory-app/ui/src apps/observatory-app/ui/style --glob '!theme.css'`""",
 r"""`rg -n -i '#[0-9a-f]{3}\b|#[0-9a-f]{6}\b|rgb\(' apps/observatory-app/ui/src apps/observatory-app/ui/style.css apps/observatory-app/ui/index.html --glob '!theme.css'`""")
# C-3
rep("C-3",
 "`exit_code` (equal to the make exit code)",
 "`exit_code` (the command's own exit code, which `scripts/gate.sh` exits with and `make` reports as `*** [<target>] Error <exit_code>`; GNU make itself exits 2 for any failing recipe)")
rep("C-3b",
 "Fail if a field is missing or empty, if `exit_code` differs from make's, or if",
 "Fail if a field is missing or empty, if `exit_code` differs from the command's (make's `Error N`), or if")
rep("C-4",
 "`seconds` (the duration, within 5 % of the wall time measured around the make call)",
 "`seconds` (the duration, within 5 % or 0.5 s of the wall time measured around the `make` call, whichever is larger)")
# C-5
rep("C-5",
 "the `HumanAction` payloads in the app log carry `text_len` / `reason_len` only (SPEC §5.9; PRD §11.2). Pass when all three greps are 0 and the column list matches.",
 "the app log's `human_action` lines carry the `HumanAction` payload with `text_len` / `reason_len` only, and no app-log line (the `host_control` lines included) carries the message, answer or reason text (`grep -c -F '<text>' <app log>` is 0 for each) (SPEC §5.9; PRD §11.2). Pass when the three store greps and the three app-log greps are 0, at least one `text_len` line exists, and the column list matches.")
rep("C-5 (Evidence, adjacent)",
 "Evidence: terminal-output(three grep counts), sqlite-query(PRAGMA table_info(human_actions)), app-log(lines with text_len)",
 "Evidence: terminal-output(three store grep counts; three app-log grep counts), sqlite-query(PRAGMA table_info(human_actions)), app-log(lines with text_len)",
 "Evidence line made to agree with the six greps")
# C-6
rep("C-6",
 "The owner's integration screenshot shows a human-overlay entry after a control (SPEC §3 M3 outcome as reworded by F-028: every control is a human-overlay event with the human as actor). Pass when the test passes and the screenshot path is recorded.",
 "The owner's integration screenshot, or the e2e PNG of the `controls.e2e.ts` Pause case under `reports/e2e/<date>/` (one PNG per test, `afterTest`), shows a human-overlay entry after a control (SPEC §3 M3 outcome as reworded by F-028: every control is a human-overlay event with the human as actor). Pass when the test passes and the screenshot path (owner's or e2e PNG) is recorded.")
rep("C-6 (Evidence)",
 "owner-screenshot(human-overlay entry at m3 integration)",
 "owner-screenshot(human-overlay entry at m3 integration) or screenshot(e2e PNG path)")
# C-7
rep("C-7",
 "Attach (not host) a mission from its session JSONL and send a message. One new",
 "Attach (not host) a mission from its session JSONL and send a message through the e2e spec `attached.e2e.ts` (a session copied under the suite's `[ingest].factory_sessions_dir`; the JUnit case is named) or, failing that, by the owner attended; validators do not click. One new")
rep("C-7 (Evidence)",
 "Evidence: sqlite-query(human_actions row), app-log(excerpt without a JSON-RPC request), owner-screenshot(or file(UI source line))",
 "Evidence: file(junit.xml case), sqlite-query(human_actions row), app-log(excerpt without a JSON-RPC request), file(UI source line) or owner-screenshot")
# C-8
rep("C-8 (lock)",
 "With the owner's display locked (or the app window fully covered by another app), `make e2e` runs:",
 "With the display locked by the owner (attended; validators never lock the display, cover the window or drive another app), `make e2e` runs:")
rep("C-8 (D-037)",
 "recorded in the e2e README and the D-row",
 "recorded in the e2e README and the harness decision file (D-037)")
rep("C-8 (Evidence, adjacent)",
 "file(e2e README section on locked displays), file(D-row sentence)",
 "file(e2e README section on locked displays), file(D-037 sentence)",
 "Evidence line made to agree with D-037")
# C-9
rep("C-9 (workflow)",
 "`.github/workflows/gate.yml` (or a `workflow_dispatch` workflow the handoff names)",
 "`.github/workflows/e2e.yml` (its own workflow, triggered by the push of the tag `e2e-<milestone>` the integrator sets on the integration commit, with `workflow_dispatch` kept for when the file is on `main`)")
rep("C-9 (budget)",
 "(the job is in `gate.yml` or dispatch-only, stated)",
 "(the job is in its own tag-triggered workflow, stated)")
rep("C-9 (run)",
 "One run per milestone: at the M3 integration the run id",
 "One run per milestone: the integrator pushes the tag at the integration commit and pastes the run id")
rep("C-9 (fail)",
 "if no green run exists by the integration commit",
 "if no green run exists for the integration commit by the end of the boundary")
# C-10
rep("C-10 (028)",
 "Runner-generated tags (`exec`, `mission-worker`, `mission-session`, `subagent`, `read-only`) never become names:",
 "Runner-generated tags (`exec`, `mission-worker`, `mission-orchestrator`, `mission-session`, `subagent`, `read-only`) never become names (Droid 0.249 writes `mission-orchestrator` first on an orchestrator session):")
rep("C-10 (039) + C-11 (column)",
 "`SELECT count(*) FROM sessions WHERE name IN ('exec','mission-worker','mission-session','subagent','read-only')`",
 "`SELECT count(*) FROM sessions WHERE tag IN ('exec','mission-worker','mission-orchestrator','mission-session','subagent','read-only')`",
 "`name` -> `tag` so the query runs against the real column (C-11 states the display name lives in sessions.tag)")
# C-11
rep("C-11 (select)",
 "`sqlite3 <scratch>.sqlite \"SELECT id, name FROM sessions ORDER BY id\"`",
 "`sqlite3 <scratch>.sqlite \"SELECT id, tag AS name FROM sessions ORDER BY id\"` (the display name lives in `sessions.tag`)")
rep("C-11 (CLI)",
 "the CLI (replay session listing or `inspect`, whichever prints names) gives the same N names;",
 "no CLI subcommand prints session names: the store written by `replay --store` is the CLI-side evidence;")
rep("C-11 (count)",
 "so the count N is equal across oracle, store, CLI and UI",
 "so the count N is equal across oracle, store and UI")
rep("C-11 (fail)",
 "if the N names differ between store, CLI and UI",
 "if the N names differ between store and UI")
rep("C-11 (Evidence CLI)",
 "terminal-output(CLI names for the N sessions)",
 "sqlite-query(SELECT id, tag AS name after replay --store)")
rep("C-11 (Evidence select, adjacent)",
 "sqlite-query(SELECT id, name FROM sessions; the runner-tag count 0)",
 "sqlite-query(SELECT id, tag AS name FROM sessions; the runner-tag count 0)",
 "Evidence line made to agree with the tag AS name query")
# C-12
rep("C-12 (eight)", "(eight actions)", "(N actions, N ≥ 8; the harness may exercise a control twice)")
rep("C-12 (both)", "both return 8", "both return N")
rep("C-12 (returns)", "WHERE e.source='app'` returns 8.", "WHERE e.source='app'` returns N.")
rep("C-12 (pass)", "Pass when all three counts are 8.", "Pass when all three counts equal N.")
rep("C-12 (Evidence)", "the eight { action_id, event_id } pairs", "the N { action_id, event_id } pairs")
# C-13
rep("C-13 (exit)",
 "the exit code equals the stored `exit_code` (the failing record replays its non-zero code)",
 "`scripts/gate.sh` exits with the stored `exit_code` and `make` reports it as `Error <exit_code>` (the failing record replays its non-zero code; make itself exits 2)")
rep("C-13 (fail)",
 "if the exit code differs from the record",
 "if gate.sh's exit code (make's `Error N`) differs from the record")

open(cp,"w").write(s)

# library follow-ups
lp=MD+"/library/user-testing.md"
l=open(lp).read()
lib=[]
def lrep(old,new):
    global l
    assert l.count(old)==1, old[:60]
    l=l.replace(old,new); lib.append((old,new))
lrep("The validator closes it by one of: (a) the contract's \"window fully covered\" path: cover the app window with another app in full screen (e.g. `osascript -e 'tell application \"TextEdit\" to activate'` then full-screen it) and run `make e2e`; or (b) when the owner's display is actually locked",
     "The locked-display run is owner-attended: validators never lock the display, cover the window or drive another app (VAL-E2E-007). The validator closes it when the owner's display is actually locked")
lrep("VAL-E2E-006's green run is dispatched by m4-integrate-m3 (`gh workflow run e2e.yml`).",
     "VAL-E2E-006's green run is triggered by the tag `e2e-m3` the integrator pushes at the integration commit.")
open(lp,"w").write(l)

# verification
heads=re.findall(r'^### (VAL-[A-Z0-9]+-\d+):', s, re.M)
st=json.load(open(MD+"/validation-state.json"))["assertions"]
keys=list(st) if isinstance(st,dict) else [a["id"] for a in st]
missing=[k for k in keys if k not in heads]
print("headings",len(heads),"unique",len(set(heads)),"state keys",len(keys),"missing",missing)

# summary file
out=["# Contract pass 25 summary","",
"Wording changes from `contract-work/m3-ut-round1-analysis.md` §4.2 applied to `validation-contract.md`; `validation-state.json` untouched.","",
"| Change | Old fragment (found verbatim) | New text | Note |","|---|---|---|---|"]
def cell(x): return x.replace("|","\\|").replace("\n"," ")
for cid,old,new,note in summary:
    out.append(f"| {cid} | `{cell(old)}` | `{cell(new)}` | {cell(note)} |")
out+=["","All old fragments were found verbatim (exactly once each). Rows marked as adjacent are sentences or Evidence lines changed so they agree with the tabulated change; the table in §4.2 did not list them.","",
"## library/user-testing.md follow-ups (line 762)",""]
for old,new in lib:
    out.append(f"- Old: `{cell(old)}`\n  New: `{cell(new)}`")
out+=["","## Verification","",
f"- `grep -c '^### VAL-'` headings: {len(heads)} (unique {len(set(heads))})",
f"- validation-state.json keys: {len(keys)}; keys without a heading: {missing}",""]
open(MD+"/contract-work/pass25-summary.md","w").write("\n".join(out))
print("ok")
